# PICO Developer Documentation: spatial

This document provides a comprehensive overview and learning roadmap for the PICO Developer documentation specific to the spatial platform.

## Document Directory

## spatial-ui

- [Divider](./spatial-ui_divider.md): This article introduces the capabilities and usage of the Divider, HorizontalDivider, and VerticalDivider components.
- [ToggleIconButton](./spatial-ui_toggleiconbutton.md): is a control defined by the PICO design guidelines, with a secondary state and designed to respond to user click interactions.
- [（暂不上线）TabBar](./spatial-ui_（暂不上线）tabbar.md): TabBar is a navigation control derived from the system widget Augment and extended via a container, helping users switch between different modules within the application.
- [TitleBar](./spatial-ui_titlebar.md): is a title bar component designed according to the PICO design guidelines, which arranges user-defined styles for the left, center, and right sections within a single row.
- [CheckBox](./spatial-ui_checkbox.md): This article introduces the features and usage of the CheckBox and TriStateCheckbox components.
- [Badge](./spatial-ui_badge.md): This article introduces the features and usage of the Badge, DotBadge, and NumberBadge components.
- [Button](./spatial-ui_button.md): is a common control in the PICO design specification, typically used to respond to user clicks.
- [ProgressIndicator](./spatial-ui_progressindicator.md): This article introduces the capabilities and usage of the LinearProgressIndicator, CircularProgressIndicator, and SymbolicCircularProgressIndicator components.
- [ListItem](./spatial-ui_listitem.md): is a general-purpose information display component defined by the PICO design specification for use in vertical lists, and is commonly used as content in Column and LazyColumn.
- [PageControl](./spatial-ui_pagecontrol.md): This article introduces the features and usage of the PageControl and ProgressPageControl components.
- [Spatial UI overview](./spatial-ui_spatial-ui-overview.md): Spatial UI includes themes and components.
- [SegmentControl](./spatial-ui_segmentcontrol.md): is a component used to switch between multiple mutually exclusive options.
- [IconButton](./spatial-ui_iconbutton.md): is a common control under the PICO design guidelines used to respond to user clicks.
- [Sheet](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_sheet.md): is a component designed under the PICO design guidelines, used to present popup content and perform tasks related to popups.
- [Toolbar](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_toolbar.md): The Toolbar is a type of container designed according to the PICO design specifications.
- [Theme](./spatial-ui_theme.md): PicoTheme is used to define the appearance style of Spatial Apps, including influencing the default behavior of each component.
- [TextField](./spatial-ui_textfield.md): is a component commonly used for text input according to the PICO design specification.
- [SideNavigation](./spatial-ui_sidenavigation.md): is a navigation control for sidebars defined by the PICO design guidelines.
- [SearchField](./spatial-ui_searchfield.md): is a component, defined under the PICO design guidelines, that allows users to enter text and initiate a search by pressing the search button on the keyboard or by other means.
- [Snack](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_snack.md): is similar to Android Toast and can be used to display brief notification messages at the bottom of the WindowContainer.
- [NumberField](./spatial-ui_numberfield.md): , designed according to the PICO design guidelines, allows users to create a numeric input field with increment and decrement buttons.
- [TextSelectionAndToolbarProvider](./spatial-ui_textselectionandtoolbarprovider.md): is a component developed under the PICO design guidelines that provides configuration for text selection and toolbar colors.
- [Coachmark](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_coachmark.md): is a component designed under the PICO design guidelines that displays content anchored to specific points.
- [Menu](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_menu.md): The menu component displays selectable list items as a floating window within a space.
- [Alert Dialog](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_alert-dialog.md): AlertDialog is a component defined by the PICO design guidelines, used to interrupt the user and prompt them.
- [TimePicker](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_timepicker.md): is a control for selecting time units—hour, minute, and second—designed according to the PICO design specification.
- [Scroll Indicator](./spatial-ui_scroll-indicator.md): The Scroll Indicator is typically used to visualize the scrolling progress on pages with long content, helping users perceive the length of the content and their current position, which enhances navig…
- [DatePicker](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_datepicker.md): This document introduces the capabilities and usage of the DatePicker and DateRangePicker components.
- [Augment](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_augment.md): is a container defined under the PICO design specification that is intended to be placed outside the main window and can be used to implement popup effects.
- [Chip](./spatial-ui_chip.md): is a control commonly used in label display scenarios under the PICO design specification.
- [Subwindow](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_subwindow.md): A Subwindow, as defined by the PICO design guidelines, is a container displayed on the left or right side of a window container, with its height always matching that of the window container.
- [ToggleButton](./spatial-ui_togglebutton.md): is a control defined by the PICO design guidelines that features a secondary state and responds to user click interactions.
- [Switch](./spatial-ui_switch.md): is a basic control in the PICO design specification that allows toggling between two states.
- [Link](./spatial-ui_link.md): is a control defined in the PICO design specification that has no background or border and is used to respond to user click interactions.
- [Option](./spatial-ui_option.md): An Option is a basic component in the PICO design specification that features a "selected" state.
- [Slider](./spatial-ui_slider.md): This article introduces the features and usage of the Slider, SegmentSlider, and SymbolSlider components.
- [SpatialPopup](./spatial-ui_spatial-window-related_spatialpopup.md): You can use the SpatialPopup component to add pop-ups with spatial floating effects (that is, spatial pop-ups) to your app, and customize the content and layout within the pop-up.

- [Shader](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader.md): This article introduces the types of shaders supported by Spatial Editor.
- [General components](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_components_component-types_general-components.md): This article introduces the general components in Spatial Editor.
- [Contrast](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_contrast.md): Adjust the contrast of the Input value (float or color) using a linear slope multiplier.
- [HSV Adjust](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_hsv-adjust.md): Adjusts the HSV of the input RGB color using a vector.
- [HSV To RGB](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_hsv-to-rgb.md): Convert a color from the HSV color space back to the RGB color space.
- [RGB To HSV](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_rgb-to-hsv.md): Convert a color from the RGB color space to the HSV color space.
- [Shader Graph quick start guide](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_shader-graph-quick-start-guide.md): This tutorial introduces how to use Shader Graph to create a glowing sphere material.
- [Luminance](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_luminance.md): Receives an RGB color as Input and outputs a grayscale value that contains the luminance information of that color in all color channels.
- [Remap](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_remap.md): Map the input value from one range to another using a linear method.
- [Range](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_range.md): Remaps an Input value within one range to another range.
- [Smooth Step](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_smooth-step.md): Using Hermite interpolation, smoothly remap an input value within the **Low** and **High** range to an output range from 0 to 1.
- [Saturate](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_adjustment_saturate.md): Adjusts the saturation of a color.
- [Convert](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_convert.md): the Input data stream from one data type to another.
- [Combine 2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_combine-2.md): Combine the channels of two data streams into a dual-channel output stream of a compatible type.
- [Combine 3](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_combine-3.md): Combine the channels of three data streams into a three-channel output stream of a compatible type.
- [Combine 4](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_combine-4.md): Combine the channels from four data streams into a compatible four-channel output stream.
- [Extract](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_extract.md): Generate a Float data stream from a single channel of the **Color N** or **Vector N** data stream.
- [Separate 3](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_separate-3.md): Output each channel of **Vector 3**, **Color 3**, or **Matrix 3** as a separate **Float** or **Float 3**.
- [Separate 2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_separate-2.md): Output each channel of **Vector 2** as a separate **Float**.
- [Swizzle](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_swizzle.md): Perform arbitrary rearrangement of the channels of the Input stream and return a new data stream of a specified type.
- [Separate 4](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_channel_separate-4.md): Output each channel of **Vector 4**, **Color 4**, or **Matrix 4** as an individual **Float** or **Float 4**.
- [Shader Graph node overview](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_shader-graph-node-overview.md): This article introduces the nodes in Shader Graph.
- [Difference](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_difference.md): Outputs the distance between the foreground and background values.
- [Dodge](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_dodge.md): is a blending operation that brightens the background layer based on the foreground.
- [Mix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_mix.md): Blend the foreground input and background input based on the weight of the **Mix** value.
- [Burn](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_burn.md): A blending operation that uses the background to darken the foreground layer.
- [Over](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_over.md): A compositing operation that uses the Alpha channel of the foreground to overlay the foreground onto the background.
- [Overlay](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_overlay.md): A blending operation that applies multiply blending to the dark areas and screen blending to the light areas.
- [Mask](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_mask.md): Outputs the area in the background that overlaps with the foreground Alpha.
- [Screen](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_screen.md): A blending operation that brightens areas darker than white.
- [Out](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_out.md): puts the areas of the foreground that do not overlap with the background.
- [Matte](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_matte.md): A merging operation that overlays a premultiplied Alpha foreground layer onto the background.
- [In](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_in.md): Outputs the regions of the foreground where the Alpha channel overlaps with the background.
- [Inside](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_inside.md): Multiply a mask across all channels of the input.
- [Additive Mix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_additive-mix.md): An operation that mixes by adding the foreground value to the background value.
- [Subtractive Mix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mode_subtractive-mix.md): Subtract the foreground value from the background value.
- [Premult](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_premult_premult.md): Multiply the input RGB channels by the input Alpha channel.
- [Outside](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_outside.md): Multiply the complement of the mask by all channels of the Input.
- [Disjoint Over](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mode_disjoint-over.md): A merging operation that overlays the foreground onto the background color, assuming that there is no overlap between the two in the shared semi-transparent region.
- [Unpremult](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_premult_unpremult.md): Divide the input RGB channels by the input Alpha channel.
- [Float](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_float.md): Constant floating-point value.
- [Integer](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_integer.md): Constant integer value.
- [Boolean](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_boolean.md): Constant Boolean value.
- [Vector3](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_vector3.md): The constant Vector3 contains three floating-point components (x, y, z).
- [Vector2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_vector2.md): A constant Vector2 that contains two floating-point components (x, y).
- [Vector4](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_vector4.md): The Vector4 constant contains four floating-point components (x, y, z, w).
- [Color4](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_color4.md): The constant Color4 vector contains four floating-point components (r, g, b, a).
- [Color3](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_color3.md): The constant Color3 vector contains three floating-point components (r, g, b).
- [Matrix4x4](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_matrix4x4.md): A constant Matrix4x4 (floating point) value (row-major order).
- [Matrix3x3](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_constant_matrix3x3.md): A constant Matrix3x3 (floating point) value (row-major order).
- [Image File](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_image-file.md): A constant path that points to a local image file.
- [Tiled Image](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_tiled-image.md): Used for sampling data from an image and provides offset and tiling functionality in UV space.
- [UV Texture](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_uv-texture.md): A MaterialX implementation of the USD UV texture reader node.
- [Bound Video Texture](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_bound-video-texture.md): Read the video texture currently bound to the entity and sample it based on the input texture coordinates.
- [Mipmap Bias Image](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_mipmap-bias-image.md): An image node containing parameters for mipmap bias across multiple levels of texture.
- [Texture Size](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_texture-size.md): Get the size of the texture and the texel.
- [Cube Image LOD](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_cube-image-lod.md): Generate and configure cube textures.
- [Image](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_image.md): Sample data from a single image or from a specific layer in a multilayer image.
- [Cube Image](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_cube-image.md): Generate and configure cube textures.
- [Video Texture LOD](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_video-texture-lod.md): Read the video texture currently bound to the entity and sample it based on the Input texture coordinates.
- [Image 2D LOD](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_image-2d-lod.md): Create a 2D texture from an image file and explicitly support specifying the LOD level used for sampling.
- [Surface Screen Position](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_surface-screen-position.md): The screen space coordinates of the currently processed data.
- [Bitangent](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_bitangent.md): The geometric bitangent vector of the data being processed in the specified space coordinate.
- [Cube Image Gradient](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_cube-image-gradient.md): Generate and configure cube textures.
- [Geom Propvalue](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_geom-propvalue.md): The value of the specified mutable geometric property currently bound to the geometry (defined using MaterialX ).
- [Image 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_texture_image-2d.md): Generate a 2D texture based on an image file.
- [Position](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_position.md): The coordinates of the currently processed data in the given space coordinate.
- [Geom Color](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_geom-color.md): The color associated with the geometry at the current position is typically defined by vertex color.
- [Normal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_normal.md): The geometric normal of the currently processed data in the given space coordinate.
- [Primvar Reader](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_primvar-reader.md): Enables the shading network to use data defined on geometry.
- [Tangent](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_tangent.md): The geometric tangent vector of the data being processed in the specified space coordinate.
- [Camera Index Switch](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_camera-index-switch.md): Renders different results for each eye in stereoscopic rendering.
- [Texture Coordinates](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_texture-coordinates.md): The two-dimensional or three-dimensional texture coordinates of the data currently being processed.
- [Two Sided Sign](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_data_two-sided-sign.md): Returns a sign value (+1 or -1) based on whether the current fragment is on the front or back side of the surface geometry.
- [Camera Position](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_camera-position.md): The position of the camera in the scene.
- [Surface Model To View](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_surface-model-to-view.md): The Matrix4x4 (Float) matrix that converts model space to view space, used for surface shading.
- [What is PICO Emulator](./spatial-toolkit_pico-emulator_what-is-pico-emulator.md): PICO Emulator is a tool that simulates the PICO OS environment on a PC.

- [Known issues](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-plugin_known-issues.md): for PICO Spatial Plugin are as follows:
- [Surface View Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_surface-view-direction.md): Returns the direction vector from the current surface shading point to the view reference point.
- [Surface Projection To View](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_surface-projection-to-view.md): Matrix4x4 (Float) that converts projection space to view space, used for surface shading.

- [View Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_view-direction.md): Returns the direction vector from the specified position to the view reference point and outputs it in the selected coordinate space.
- [Surface Model To World](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_surface-model-to-world.md): The Matrix4x4 (Float) transformation matrix from the model to the world.
- [Vertex Model To View](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-model-to-view.md): A Matrix4x4 (Float) matrix that converts model space to view space, used for vertex shading.
- [Surface World To View](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_surface-world-to-view.md): A Matrix4x4 (Float) that transforms world space to view space, used for surface shading.
- [Vertex World To Model](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-world-to-model.md): A Matrix4x4 (Float) matrix that converts world space to model space, used for vertex shading.
- [Vertex Model To World](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-model-to-world.md): Matrix4x4 (Float) used to convert model space to world space for the Vertex Shader.
- [Vertex Normal To World](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-normal-to-world.md): A Matrix3x3 (Float) matrix that transforms vertex normals from model space to world space.
- [Vertex Projection To View](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-projection-to-view.md): A Matrix4x4 (Float) matrix for converting projection space to view space, used for vertex shading.
- [Vertex View To Projection](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_vertex-view-to-projection.md): A Matrix4x4 (float) that converts view space to projection space for vertex shading.
- [Time](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_time.md): Outputs the current time (in seconds) of the local environment.
- [Up Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_up-direction.md): The direction of the upward vector.
- [Scene Texel Size](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_scene-texel-size.md): Provides information about the size of the current scene texture, as well as the normalized size corresponding to a single texel.
- [Camera Up Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_camera-up-direction.md): Returns the float3 directional vector of the camera's current up direction.
- [Camera Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_camera-direction.md): Returns the camera's current orientation as a float 3 direction vector.
- [Exponential 2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_exponential-2.md): 2 to the power of X.
- [Absval](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_absval.md): Outputs the absolute value of each input channel.
- [Exp](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_exp.md): Returns e raised to the power of the input value.
- [Exponential 10](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_exponential-10.md): 10 to the power of X.
- [Log](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_log.md): Natural logarithm.
- [Modulo](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_modulo.md): After dividing **In 1** by **In 2**, subtract the integer part, then output the remaining fractional part.
- [Log 2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_log-2.md): The logarithm with base 2.
- [Log 10](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_log-10.md): A logarithm with base 10.
- [Normal Map Decode](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_normal-map-decode.md): By applying the formula `2x - 1`, the range of normal values can be remapped from `[0, 1]` to `[-1, 1]`.
- [Distance](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_distance.md): Returns the distance between X and Y.
- [DDY](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_ddy.md): Returns the partial derivative of the input value in the screen space Y direction.
- [Distance Square](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_distance-square.md): Returns the square of the distance between X and Y.
- [Fractional](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_range_fractional.md): Returns the fractional part of a floating-point number.
- [DDX](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_advanced_ddx.md): Returns the partial derivative of the input value in the screen-space X direction.
- [Clamp](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_range_clamp.md): Restrict the Input for each channel to the range between **Low** and **High**.
- [Max](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_range_max.md): Outputs the maximum value between **In 1** and **In 2**.
- [Min](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_range_min.md): Output the minimum value between **In 1** and **In 2**.
- [One Minus](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_range_one-minus.md): Subtract the input value from 1.
- [Floor](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_round_floor.md): Outputs, per channel, the nearest integer less than or equal to the input value.
- [Ceil](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_round_ceil.md): Outputs, per channel, the nearest integer greater than or equal to the input value.
- [Step](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_round_step.md): If **In** < **Edge**, return 0.0; otherwise, return 1.0.
- [Sign](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_round_sign.md): The sign of the input value for each channel: negative numbers are -1, positive numbers are +1, and zero is 0.
- [Cross Product](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_cross-product.md): Calculate the cross product of two input vectors.
- [Dot Product](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_dot-product.md): Outputs the dot product of two vectors.
- [Transform Normal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_transforms_transform-normal.md): Transform the normal vector from one space coordinate to another space coordinate.
- [Magnitude](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_magnitude.md): The floating-point magnitude of the output vector.
- [Reflect](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_reflect.md): Calculate the reflection of a vector with respect to another vector.
- [Normalize](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_normalize.md): Output the normalized vector.
- [Normal Map](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_normal-map.md): Convert normal vectors from object space or tangent space to world space.
- [Refract](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_refract.md): Calculate the refracted vector based on the given surface normal and refractive index (eta).
- [Rotate 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_rotate-2d.md): Rotate a 2D vector about the origin in two-dimensional space.
- [Rotate 3D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_rotate-3d.md): Rotate a 3D vector around a specified unit axis vector.
- [Determinant](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_matrix_determinant.md): Outputs the floating-point determinant of the matrix.
- [Place 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_geometry_place-2d.md): Transforms the UV texture coordinates used for 2D texture placement.
- [Inverse Matrix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_matrix_inverse-matrix.md): Outputs the inverse of the matrix.
- [Ramp 4 Corners](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_ramp-4-corners.md): Four-point linear gradient generator.
- [Cell Noise 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_cell-noise-2d.md): 2D cellular noise generator.
- [Noise 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_noise-2d.md): 2D Perlin noise generator.
- [Ramp Horizontal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_ramp-horizontal.md): A generator for linear value gradients (ramps) from left to right.
- [Transpose](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_matrix_transpose.md): Output the transpose of the matrix.
- [Split Horizontal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_split-horizontal.md): Split the mask from left to right at the specified U value.
- [Ramp Vertical](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_ramp-vertical.md): A generator for linear value gradients (ramps) from top to bottom.
- [Split Vertical](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_split-vertical.md): Split the mask from top to bottom at the specified V value.
- [Cellular Noise 3D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_3d-procedural_cellular-noise-3d.md): 3D cellular noise generator.
- [Worley Noise 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_2d-procedural_worley-noise-2d.md): 2D Worley noise generator.
- [Fractal Noise 3D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_3d-procedural_fractal-noise-3d.md): By stacking multiple 3D Perlin noise layers (octaves) with different frequencies and amplitudes, a 3D fractal noise is generated that fluctuates around zero.
- [Worley Noise 3D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_3d-procedural_worley-noise-3d.md): 3D Worley noise generator.
- [Noise 3D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_procedural_3d-procedural_noise-3d.md): 3D Perlin noise generator.
- [Transform 2D](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_transforms_transform-2d.md): A node that applies an affine transformation to 2D input.
- [Transform Matrix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_transforms_transform-matrix.md): Transform vectors using a matrix.
- [Transform Point](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_transforms_transform-point.md): Transform coordinates from one coordinate space to another.
- [Transform Vector](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_transforms_transform-vector.md): Transform a 3D vector from one space coordinate to another.
- [Tan](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_tan.md): The tangent value (in radians) of the input value.
- [Cos](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_cos.md): The cosine value of the input (in radians).
- [Acos](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_acos.md): The arccosine value (in radians) of the input value.
- [Sin](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_sin.md): The sine of the input value (in radians).
- [Asin](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_asin.md): The arc sine value (in radians) of the input value.
- [Vertex Index](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_vertex_vertex-index.md): Returns the index value of the current vertex in the mesh.
- [Atan2](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_atan2.md): The arctangent (in radians) of **In Y** divided by **In X**.
- [PI](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_trigonometry_pi.md): Returns PI (π).
- [Occlusion Surface](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_surface_occlusion-surface.md): A surface shader that defines the properties for occlusion materials that do not receive dynamic lighting.
- [Preview Surface](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_surface_preview-surface.md): MaterialX version of USD Preview Surface.
- [Unlit Surface](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_surface_unlit-surface.md): Surface shader for unlit materials.
- [Geometry Modifier](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_vertex_geometry-modifier.md): Modify the vertex properties of the geometry based on the input parameters, and execute once for each vertex.
- [Object Bounds](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_object-bounds.md): Returns the bounding box information of the object in the specified space, including size, minimum coordinates, and maximum coordinates.
- [Or](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_or.md): Logical OR operation on the two Boolean values **In 1** and **In2**.
- [PBR Surface](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_surface_pbr-surface.md): Shader for surfaces of physically based rendering (PBR) materials.
- [Node Graph](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_node-graph.md): Can contain shader nodes and nodes from other node graphs.
- [Dot](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_dot.md): A relay node used to visually guide connections in a node graph.
- [Named Dot](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_named-dot.md): Node for value transfer.
- [Debug Value](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_debug-value.md): Render the input value onto the surface for display.
- [Environment Radiance](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_environment-radiance.md): Based on real-world environmental information and an IBL map (which can be provided by the user or the default map can be used), returns the environment's diffuse radiance value and specular radiance…
- [What is Timelines](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_animation_timelines_what-is-timelines.md): Timelines is an animation effects tool provided by Spatial Editor.
- [Instance Custom Data](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_instance-custom-data.md): This is used to return the floating-point value stored in the custom data of a `MeshInstancesResource` instance in the PICO Spatial SDK.
- [Fresnel Effect](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_fresnel-effect.md): The Fresnel effect is calculated based on the direction of the surface normal and the view direction.
- [Sticky Note](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_other_sticky-note.md): , used to add annotations to the node graph.
- [Add animation effects to entities](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_animation_timelines_add-animation-effects-to-entities.md): This article describes how to use Timelines to add animation effects to entities.
- [Not](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_not.md): Return the result of the logical NOT (!) operation on the Input.
- [Configure texture files](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_textures_configure-texture-files.md): This article describes how to configure texture files in Spatial Editor.
- [Known issues](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_known-issues.md): The known issues of PICO Spatial Editor are as follows:
- [If Greater](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_if-greater.md): Outputs different results depending on whether **Value1** is greater than **Value2**: if **Value1** > **Value2**, outputs **True Result**; otherwise, outputs **False Result**.
- [Xor](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_xor.md): Logical exclusive OR (XOR) operation between two Boolean values, **In1** and **In2**.
- [Object Up Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_object-up-direction.md): Returns the float3 direction vector of the object's up direction in the specified space.
- [Object Forward Direction](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_object-forward-direction.md): Returns the float3 direction vector of the object's forward direction in the specified space coordinate.
- [If Equal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_if-equal.md): Output different results based on whether **Value1** is equal to **Value2**: if they are equal, output **True Result**; otherwise, output **False Result**.
- [Sqrt](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_sqrt.md): Calculate the square root of a value.
- [Actions supported by Timelines](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_animation_timelines_actions-supported-by-timelines.md): This article describes the actions supported by Timelines and the configurable parameters for each action.
- [Subtract](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_subtract.md): s two values.
- [If Greater Or Equal](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_if-greater-or-equal.md): Output different results based on whether **Value1** is greater than or equal to **Value2**: if **Value1** >= **Value2**, output **True Result**; otherwise, output **False Result**.
- [Open Source Software Notices for PICO Spatial Plugin](./spatial-toolkit_open-source-software-notices_open-source-software-notices-for-pico-spatial-plugin.md): THE FOLLOWING SETS FORTH ATTRIBUTION NOTICES FOR THIRD PARTY SOFTWARE THAT MAY BE CONTAINED IN PORTIONS OF THIS PRODUCT.
- [Switch](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_switch.md): Based on the value of the selector switch input, select and output a value from 10 Input streams.
- [Power](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_power.md): Calculate the specified power of a value.
- [Add](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_add.md): two values.
- [Divide](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_divide.md): two values.
- [Safe Power](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_safe-power.md): Calculates the specified power of a value and assigns the sign of the base to the output.
- [Multiply](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_math_basic_multiply.md): two values.
- [Manage scenes](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_scenes_manage-scenes.md): This article describes how to manage scenes in Spatial Editor.
- [Object Position](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_object-position.md): Returns the float3 position vector of the object's origin in the specified space coordinate.
- [Object Radius](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_input_global_object-radius.md): Returns the bounding radius of the object in the specified space coordinate.
- [And](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_logic_and.md): The logical AND operation between two Boolean values, **In 1** and **In2**.

## Learning Roadmap

The recommended learning order is:

1. **Orientation** — Read `Understand PICO Spatial SDK and spatial apps`, then the `Quickstart` pages (Step 1 / Step 2) to set up the environment and run your first app. Complement with `Project structure and dependency configuration`, `Upgrade SDK`, and `Release notes`.
2. **Core runtime model** — Learn the ECS architecture: `Learn about the ECS architecture`, `Create and query entities`, `Built-in components`, `Customize systems and components`, then entity lifecycle topics (clone, orientation, bounding box, events). Pair with `Event system`.
3. **Spatial containers & space state** — Understand `Spatial containers & space state`, the default container / activity, then manage Stages and WindowContainers (declare, open/close, lifecycle). This is required before shipping a real app.
4. **Rendering & materials** — Opacity, model rendering order, dynamic lighting/shadowing, image-based lighting, `ShaderGraphMaterial`, particles, and portals. Spatial-toolkit's Shader Graph reference (adjustment/channel/composition/input/math/surface nodes) underpins custom looks.
5. **Content layout & UI** — Themes and components of Spatial UI, 2D panels on 3D entities, spatial effects (floating, hover, rotation, scaling, depth & layout, glass, tooltip, spatial components), Vibrant style, and every `spatial-ui` control.
6. **Interaction & tracking** — `Implement basic interactions for 3D objects`, hover highlight, interact with entities, drag-and-drop, drag via mouse, custom interaction events, interactive sound effects, spatial gestures; then tracking docs (HMD, controller, hand, eye, body, object) with `Use DataProvider`.
7. **Audio & video** — Audio overview, Ambient/Object/Channel audio components, audio events, audio mixer groups, audio group resources, immersive audio sample; video overview, `VideoComponent` / `VideoMaterial` / `VideoPlayerComponent`, projection mode, and the spatial video sample.
8. **Physics & math** — Physics simulation process, colliders & forces, raycast, physics world parameters, `Sample: Add physics to your app`; coordinate space & length unit conversion.
9. **SpatialML & MR sensing** — `SpatialML overview`, basic concepts, best practices, privacy statement, `Get started with SpatialML`, plus SensePack plane detection / spatial mesh / spatial anchor and the super-resolution sample.
10. **Animation** — Animation system, composition & playback control, timeline, tween, orbit, skeletal, blend shape, animation events, and the `Animate your 3D models` sample.
11. **Performance & tooling** — Performance overview, scene complexity, 3D rendering pipeline & analysis, performance optimization, enable HD UI rendering, Metrics HUD, retrieve & analyze trace records, notes on experimental APIs, and port Android apps.
12. **Authoring with spatial-toolkit** — `What is PICO Spatial Editor` / `What is PICO Spatial Plugin` / `What is PICO Emulator`; install each tool; manage Spatial Editor projects, scenes, nodes, views, entities, components, assets, materials, textures, and audio mixer; timelines & actions; and consult Shader Graph nodes as needed. Finish with open-source notices and known issues for each sub-tool.

## Practical Use Cases

- **Bring up a brand-new spatial app** → Read `Understand PICO Spatial SDK and spatial apps`, `Step 1: Set up the development environment`, `Step 2: Create your first spatial app`, and `Project structure and dependency configuration`. Then follow `About the default spatial container and default activity`.
- **Build a spatialized 2D UI with Spatial UI** → Consult `Themes and components of Spatial UI`, the 2D-to-spatial effect docs (Spatial components / floating / rotation / scaling / hover / depth and layout / glass / tooltip), `Vibrant style`, and the `spatial-ui` control references (`Button`, `ListItem`, `TitleBar`, `SideNavigation`, ...).
- **Author a 3D scene with interaction and animation** → Use `Implement basic interactions for 3D objects`, `Interact with entities`, `Customize spatial interaction events`, `Spatial gesture`; combine with `Animation system`, `Timeline animation`, `Skeletal animation`, and `Sample: Animate your 3D models`.
- **Ship an MR experience** → Read `SpatialML overview` → `SpatialML basic concepts` → `Get started with SpatialML` → `SpatialML best practices`; combine with `Plane detection`, `Spatial mesh`, `Spatial anchor`, and `Sample: super resolution camera`. Check `SpatialML privacy statement` before release.
- **Add physics to a spatial app** → Follow `Physics simulation process`, `Add collisions and external forces`, `Set parameters for the physics world`, `Raycast`, and the `Sample: Add physics to your app` walkthrough.
- **Author custom materials** → Start from `ShaderGraphMaterial`, `What is Shader Graph`, `Navigate the Shader Graph UI`, `Shader Graph quick start guide`, then drill into the specific Shader Graph node references (adjustment / channel / composition / input / math / procedural / surface / transforms / trigonometry / logic / other nodes).
- **Build an immersive audio scene** → Use `Overview` (audio), `Use AmbientAudioComponent`, `Use ObjectAudioComponent`, `Use ChannelAudioComponent`, `Use audio events`, `Use audio mixer group`, `Using audio group resources`, and `Sample: Create an immersive audio experience`.
- **Play spatial video inside the app** → Read `Overview` (video), `Projection mode`, `Use VideoComponent`, `Use VideoMaterial`, `Use VideoPlayerComponent`, and `Sample: Play spatial videos in your app`.
- **Optimize performance & diagnose issues** → Start with `Overview` (performance), `Performance optimization`, `Scene complexity`, `3D rendering process and performance analysis`, `Enable high-definition UI rendering`, `Metrics HUD`, and `Retrieve and analyze trace records`.
- **Port an existing Android app** → Follow `Port Android apps` alongside `Project structure and dependency configuration`, `Upgrade SDK`, and `Known issues`.
- **Author assets in PICO Spatial Editor + emulate on PC** → Read `What is PICO Spatial Editor`, `Install PICO Spatial Editor`, `Navigate the Spatial Editor UI`, `Manage Spatial Editor projects`, scene/node/view/entity/component/asset management docs, the Shortcuts reference, `Supported 3D model formats`, then pair with `What is PICO Emulator`, `Install PICO Emulator`, `Manage apps on PICO Emulator`, `UI debugging`, and `Controller button mode`.
- **Integrate spatial workflow into an existing Unity/Unreal engine project** → Use `What is PICO Spatial Plugin`, `Install PICO Spatial Plugin`, `Manage spatial projects`, `Manage custom components`, `Manage resources`, and `Manage spatial app development tools`.
